 J U D G M E N T

The PI, Hennur police station, has submitted charge sheet against the accused persons for the offence punishable U/s.498A, 342, 307, 504 r/w.34 of IPC and Section.3 and 4 of D.P Act in Crime Hennuru P S vs A1-Murugesh.K on 30 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/71423497/
2 No.296/2019 of Hennur P.S.
2.

The brief story of the prosecution are as under:
The marriage between accused No.1 and complainant Smt.Girija @ Geetha performed on 27.11.2015 at Yelagooreshwara temple situated at Muddebihala Taluk.
At the time of marriage, parents of the complainant gave ornament to the accused as dowry.
After marriage, they started to reside in Bengaluru at house No.13, Andra Muniyappa layout, Chelekere, Bengaluru.
Due to the marital relationship, the complainant gave birth to baby girl.
After sometime, the accused No.1 started to demand additional dowry to the complainant.
As such, the parents have gave money as dowry to the accused No.1.
Thereafter, accused No.1 has looked after the complainant very well for some time and again started to torture the complainant physically and mentally by abusing in filthy language.
The accused Nos.2 to 4 alongwith accused No.1 not only abused the complainant, but also harassed physically and mentally.
On 05.09.2019 at 10.00 a.m accused No.1 picked up quarrel with complainant and assaulted with hands and wrongfully confined in the house.

On 06.09.2019 at 5.30 a.m the accused persons made the complainant to consume phenyl forcibly with an intention to kill the complainant and thereby the accused persons have committed the offences as alleged against them.
3. The concerned police have submitted charge sheet before the concerned ACMM., Bangalore.

The learned Magistrate has took cognizance of the offences and committed the case to the Sessions Court by complying Sec.207 of Cr.P.C. after furnishing copy of charge sheet to the accused Nos.1 to 4.

The same was numbered as SC No.1107/2021.
4.
The prosecution has examined eight witnesses as PW.1 to PW.8 and got exhibited documents at Ex.P1 to P9.

Inspite of issue of summons, warrant and proclamation against C.W.2 the police failed to execute warrant and produce her before the court to record her evidence, as such the prayer of the learned PP was rejected and the witness CW.2 was dropped.

However liberty has been given to the prosecution for examination of the said witness, if the said witness brought before the court by the concerned police before conclusion of trial.
5.
After completion of prosecution side evidence, this Court has recorded the statement of accused persons, as provided U/s.313 of Cr.P.C.
The accused persons have denied incriminating evidence present against them and not claimed any defense evidence nor submitted anything to the Court.
The accused persons have complied application u/s.437A of Cr.PC by executing personal bond and surety bond.

6. Heard the arguments on both sides and perused the materials on record.
7.

The following points that arises for consideration of this court:
Hennuru P S vs A1-Murugesh.K on 30 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/71423497/
3 1.

Whether the prosecution proves that 27.11.2015 the accused married the complainant Smt.Girija @ Geetha at Muddebihala Taluk, as per the customs prevailed in their community, and at the time of marriage accused No.1 being husband and accused Nos.2 to 4 being the family members on demand received amount as dowry and subjecting the complainant to physical and mental cruelty by demanding additional dowry from her parental house and thereby accused persons have committed an offence punishable U/s.3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961 ?
2. Whether the prosecution proves that the accused No.1 and complainant-Smt.
Girija @ Geetha are being the husband and wife and are residing at house No.13,
Andra Muniyappa layout, Chelekere, Bengaluru, and accused Nos.2 to 4 are being the relatives of husband of complainant-Smt. Girija @ Geetha with common intention subjected complainant to physical and mental cruelty for additional dowry by abusing her in filthy language and thereby accused persons have committed an offence punishable u/s 498A r/w Sec.34 of IPC?
3. Whether the prosecution proves that on 05.09.2019 at 10.00 p.m the accused persons in prosecution of their common intention, the accused persons wrongfully restrained the complainant from proceeding further and wrongfully confined her in the house No.13, Andra Muniyappa layout, Chelekere, Bengaluru and thereby accused persons have committed the offence punishable punishable U/s.342 r/w Sec.34 of IPC?
4. Whether the prosecution proves that on 05.09.2019 at 10.00 p.m the accused persons in prosecution of their common intention, accused persons quarreled with C.W.1 and abused her in filthy language knowingly that such provocation will cause the said person to break the public peace and thereby accused persons have committed an offence punishable under section 504 r/w.34 of IPC?
5. Whether the prosecution proves that on 06.09.2019 at 5.30 p.m accused persons quarreled with C.W.1 and with an intention and knowledge to kill C.W.1 forced her to consume phenyl and thereby accused persons have committed an offence punishable U/s.307 r/w.34 of IPC?
6. What order?
8. This Court has answered the above above points are as under:
 Point No.1: In the Negative  Point No.2: In the Negative  Point No.3: In the Negative  Point No.4: In the Negative  Point No.5: In the Negative  Point No.6: As per final order  for the following:
Hennuru P S vs A1-Murugesh.K on 30 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/71423497/
4  R E A S O N S 9.
Points Nos.1 to 5: These points are taken up together as they are related to each other and to avoid repetition in the discussion.
The prosecution examined prime witness complainant/victim, who is alleged to be suffered in the hands of accused Nos.1 to 4 as P.W.1.
The said P.W.1 Girija @ Geetha being the complainant never deposed demand of dowry by the accused persons and giving dowry at the time of marriage or subsequently.

According to the said witness, the accused persons never confined her in a room and forced her to consume phenyl with an intention to kill her and also never tortured to bring additional dowry nor abused or assaulted.
According to P.W.1, due to the family dispute when she went to the police station, at that time, police have obtained her signatures on complaint and Mahazar marked at Ex.P.1 and Ex.P.2.
Further the evidence also shows that police have not recorded her further statement with regard to accused persons mae the C.W.1 to consume phenyl.
The further statement has been marked at Ex.P.3.
The prosecution also got examined the brother of complainant Santhosh as P.W.3, mother of the complainant as P.W.4 and neighbour resident by name Smt.Savitha as P.W.8.
The said witnesses P.W.3, P.W.4 and P.W.8 also not deposed in accordance with their statements or story of the prosecution.

Even though the evidence of P.W.3 and P.W.4 clearly shows about the marriage of accused No.1 with the complainant and giving of birth to a baby girl by name Kushi by the complainant due to the marital relationship, perhaps never deposed about physical and mental torture alleged to be given by the accused persons to the complainant.
According to the neighbour P.W.8 she never saw disputes between the complainant and accused persons and also not pacified the quarrel.
According to the said witnesses, the police have not recorded their statements.

As the evidence of P.W.1, P.W.3, P.W.4 and P.W.8 contrary to their own statements, hence, learned PP has cross-examined PW.1, P.W.3, P.W.4 and P.W.8 treating them as hostile with the permission of the court.
Inspite of atmost efforts of the learned PP, not able to bring any worthful evidence through the witnesses P.W.1, P.W.3, P.W.4 and P.W.8 to believe story of prosecution.
As such, the evidence of family members including the complainant and neighbour not helpful for the prosecution to prove the allegations made against the accused persons.
10. It is necessary to note that the pancha P.W.2 Ramesh Koloru being the signatory to the Mahazar Ex.P.2 failed to give evidence about the contents of the Mahazar.
Even though the complainant is the sister, but according to his evidence he does not know the contents of the Mahazar and police have not conducted Mahazar as per Ex.P.2 in his present at spot
. According to him, the police obtained the signatures in the police station.
As such the learned PP has cross-examined the said witness PW.2, but failed to get any supporting evidence to prove the Mahazar Ex.P.2.

As such, the evidence given by the witness P.W.2 not helpful for the prosecution to prove the contents of Mahazar Ex.P.2.
11.
It is necessary to note that P.W.6 H.D.Kulkarni, the then PI received complaint on 10.09.2019 at 7.00 p.m.
He has registered FIR vide Cr.No.296/2019 against the accused persons.
On the next day i.e. on 11.09.2019 visited spot, conducted Mahazar in the presence of panchas shown by the complainant.

On 12.09.2019, the complainant produced the marriage photos, birth certificate,
Hennuru P S vs A1-Murugesh.K on 30 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/71423497/
5 hospital records, the said documents even marked at Ex.P.7 and thereafter recorded further statement of C.W.1 and also statements of witnesses C.W.4 to C.W.6.
On 15.09.2019 collected hospital records related to C.W.1 as per Ex.P.8 and thereafter handed over further investigation to C.W.8/P.W.5 Srinivas.B.M.
The said witness P.W.5 Srinivas.B.M. being the Police Inspector deposed that on 19.10.2019, the accused Nos.2 to 4 appeared alongwith bail order of the court.
He has carried out arrest procedure against them and released them on bail.
He has deputed the police to trace and produce accused No.1 before him.
On 26.11.2020, he has handed over further investigation to the witness C.W.9/P.W.7 Vasanth Kumar.
The said witness P.W.7 being the then PI on 21.03.2021 when the accused No.1 appeared before him alongwith court order, he has arrested him and released on bail.
As the investigation was completed, hence submitted charge sheet against the accused persons.
The evidence given by P.W.5, P.W.6 and P.W.7 has been completely denied by the accused counsel.

The evidence given by the Police Official witnesses and the discharge summary Ex.P.8 related to complainant not match with the evidence of the victim P.W.1 and also not supported by the other family members and neighbour of P.W.1 as already discussed above.
The complainant specifically deposed that she has never taken treatment in the hospital.

So, it is very clear that the prosecution has failed to prove the allegations made against the accused persons that the accused persons harassed the complainant physically and mentally, abusing in filthy language and wrongfully confined her in a room for additional dowry and also forced her to consume phenyl with an intention to kill her.
Hence, this court has answered the Point Nos.1 to 5 in the Negative.
12. Point No.6:

In view of answer of this court on points No.1 to 5, this court proceed to pass the following:
O R D E R U/s.235(1) of Cr.P.C. the accused No.1 to 4 are hereby acquitted of the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 342, 307, 504 r/w.34 of IPC And Section.3 and 4 of D.P Act.
The bail bond and surety bond of accused Nos.1 to 4 stands cancelled.
